plan.summary:
This PR documents the new `retries` option in the Requests guide. It adds a Retries section with a per-language example in tabs.

- Imports the `Tabs` and `TabItem` components.
- Adds a `## Retries` section with a TypeScript and a Python example.
plan.riskRationale: Documentation-only change to one MDX file. No runtime code is touched.
plan.storyArc: The guide needs to describe `retries`. The page first imports the tab components. Then it uses them in a new Retries section.

topics.title: Retries section with per-language tabs
topics.narrativeBrief: How does the guide present the `retries` option? Connect the Tabs imports to the new section that uses them. Verify the TabItem usage matches the imported components.
